sentences.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA  No. 2025 CRIMINAL REVISIONAL JURISDICTION  10 APPELLATE SIDE Ct 32 CRR 4929 of 2024 rup Bablu Paramanik & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Mujibar Ali Naskar,
 Mr. Sandip Kr. Mondal,
 Ms. Riya Das ... for the petitioners.
 1.
This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing of the proceeding with regard to Sessions Case No. 10 of 2024 (corresponding to G.R. Case No. 277 of 2022) in connection with Adra Police Station Case No. 46 of 2022 dated 01.05.2022 under Sections 498A/ 307/ 354/34 of the Indian Penal Code, read with Section 3 /4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that after chargesheet,
documents were supplied in compliance with provisions of Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and has referred to the statement recorded during investigation.
3. It has been further submitted that the allegations are general and did not specify any particular role of any of the petitioners.
4. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners as well as having gone through the documents annexed herewith, the same stands admitted.

5. Petitioners are directed to serve notice along with copy of the revisional application with all annexures upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

6. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners also prayed for stay of the proceeding involved in this revisional application, otherwise the very purpose of filing of this revisional application shall be frustrated.

7. Regard being had to the above, let the proceeding in connection with Sessions Case No. 10 of 2024 (corresponding to G.R. Case No. 277 of 2022) pending before the Court of Learned Additional Rup Bablu Paramanik & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65485616/

8. Let the matter appear one week after Puja Vacation, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
9. Liberty is given to the petitioners to file supplementary.
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
